answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold: a new identity earns full rewards only after trading with 20 distinct counterparties over 10 epochs, each signed on an ivory register. An identity stuck on one island of clones never qualifies. Forging 1,000 identities needs 20,000 links; renting each at 50 units costs 1,000,000 units, versus zero for one honest agent. Honest agents already trade across the wider ocean, so they pass at once, rewards undiluted.
